# Compiler — Known Issues

Layer-specific quirks for the compiler. Load when working under
`src/{Compilers,Dependencies,ExpressionEvaluator,Tools}`. Cross-cutting issues
(generated code, CI marker gating, environmental test failures) live in
`.github/memory/KNOWN_ISSUES.md`.

## BenchmarkDotNet runner output properties

**Affected area:** `src/Tools/IdeCoreBenchmarks`

**Description:** BenchmarkDotNet builds an autogenerated runner with `ArtifactsPath`,
`OutDir`, `OutputPath`, and `PublishDir` global properties. If those properties flow
through Roslyn's project-reference graph, multi-targeted projects share output and
intermediate directories, causing file-write races and mixed-framework compiler
errors.

**Workaround:** The benchmark host sets
`_GlobalPropertiesToRemoveFromProjectReferences` in the environment before invoking
BenchmarkDotNet. Keep BenchmarkDotNet output properties in that removal list so the
generated runner retains its isolated output while referenced Roslyn projects use
their normal project- and target-framework-specific paths.
